content:
Skip to content Intensive English Program The Westcliff University ’s Intensive English Program , the REAL Pathway program, is the first Intensive English programs to be offered by a university 100% online and for academic credit. Through using the flipped classroom model, this innovative online program helps students prepare for their studies by training them to be proactive and autonomous learners. Aside from acquiring the necessary academic skills to be successful in their new educational environments, students who successfully complete the REAL Pathway Program gain reading, listening, writing, and speaking skills that are equivalent to IELTS, PTE, or TOEFLiBT scores that universities accept for undergraduate and graduate admission while also earning academic credits and acquiring soft skills through pair work and group work in small classes.
